description: The Google Ads API is a programmatic interface for managing Google Ads accounts and campaigns, suitable for large or complex setups. Typical uses include automated account management, custom reporting, ad management based on inventory, and Smart Bidding strategy management. It is recommended for developers comfortable with writing code and managing their own software infrastructure.
api_breadth: The API allows managing accounts from the customer level down to the keyword level, including account management, reporting, ad management, bidding strategies, and more, suitable for large or complex Google Ads accounts and campaigns.

api_breadth: The Notion API supports workspace content management including pages, databases, views, comments, markdown content, files, and media. It supports internal connections with static tokens, personal access tokens, and public connections via OAuth 2.0. The API includes endpoints for user info, page content, and more, with SDK support for JavaScript.
